raw.summary: Innoviva, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company in the United States and internationally. Its royalty portfolio includes RELVAR/BREO ELLIPTA, a once-daily combination medicine consisting of a LABA, vilanterol, and an inhaled corticosteroid, and fluticasone furoate; ANORO ELLIPTA, a once-daily medicine combining a long-acting muscarinic antagonist, umeclidinium bromide, and ABA, VI.
